themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents designed to autonomously perform research tasks, manage workflows, and interact with data or systems for research purposes.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Focuses on AI-powered platforms, software, and tools specifically developed to assist or automate various aspects of research.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code, including security aspects and agentic behavior.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the creation and use of artificial personas or data to simulate user behavior for testing and research.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Highlights AI applications assisting product managers in areas like ideation, roadmapping, and data analysis for product development.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to analyze customer feedback, reviews, and sentiment to extract actionable insights.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools and techniques used to automate software testing processes, including quality engineering and security testing.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Discusses AI's role in evaluating and improving the usability of products and systems.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, rank, or review different AI tools and platforms for specific use cases.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
